about:
Automotive Charging & Starting LLC was founded in 2011 by Brian Webb in Idaho Falls, Idaho. Webb brought over 20 years of experience from AC&S to establish an independently owned and operated shop focused on automotive electrical systems at 935 Lindsay Boulevard.

The company provides battery sales, service, and recycling, along with repair and rebuilding of alternators, starters, generators, and DC motors. It maintains a large inventory of parts from OEM and aftermarket suppliers such as Delco, Bosch, Denso, and Mitsubishi, and offers same-day completion for most jobs unless parts must be ordered. A 24-hour emergency service, free battery checks, free installation, and a battery buy-back program round out the offering.

The shop serves automotive, commercial, industrial, agricultural, marine, recreational, and truck customers across a wide range of brands, including Japanese, European, and domestic manufacturers from Acura to Volvo and from Chrysler to Ford.

Webb started the business to deliver value to the community through outstanding service, a no-hassle guarantee, and free diagnostics for no-start conditions, aiming to recommend the least expensive solution rather than replace unnecessary parts.
